verdict.rationale: Base44 docs mention connecting external AI agents to an app's 'sandbox' (docs-3, docs-37) and a dedicated testing agent that runs browser-based simulated flows (docs-44), suggesting some isolation from live production, but there is no explicit description of a staging/test environment with separate data storage or guarantees that testing won't affect production records. missing for 10: explicit staging/production data separation, documentation of how the testing agent avoids mutating real data, independent confirmation that sandbox use is isolated.
